implementation_notes: This is a non-binding regulatory guidance document (version 2.0, revised April 2025) issued jointly by the Digital Platform Government Committee and NIA for the South Korean public sector. It covers hyperscale/generative AI (초거대 AI/LLM) adoption across central ministries, local governments, and public institutions. Key obligations are framed as principles and checklists rather than legally enforceable mandates. Data security classification (C/S/O) and CSAP cloud certification requirements reference existing binding law (클라우드컴퓨팅법, 정보공개법, N2SF). AI ethics compliance references the MSIT AI Ethics Guidelines (2020). The document does not specify civil or criminal penalties; enforcement relies on existing procurement and cloud security regulatory frameworks. Performance management framework (Part 4) provides KPI pools for AI project lifecycle evaluation.
